skill.name: Excel / XLSX
skill.description: Create, inspect, and edit Microsoft Excel workbooks and XLSX files with reliable formulas, dates, types, formatting, recalculation, and template preservation. Use when (1) the task is about Excel, `.xlsx`, `.xlsm`, `.xls`, `.csv`, or `.tsv`; (2) formulas, formatting, workbook structure, or compatibility matter; (3) the file must stay reliable after edits.
